month.etymology: Old English monaþ, from Proto-Germanic *mēnōþaz (moon, month)

flower.etymology: Old English flowr, from Old French flor, from Latin flōs (flower, bloom)

animal.etymology: Old French animal, from Latin anima (soul, spirit, living being)

dog.etymology: Old English docga, origin uncertain; possibly from a personal name or Germanic base

cat.etymology: Old English catt, from Latin cattus or cattus (cat)

bird.etymology: Old English brid (young bird, nestling), from Proto-Germanic *breudaz
